tenderSchedule.title: Providing electrification with new fixtures to renovated residential building for PC-6 at SVP colony, Jogfalls
tenderSchedule.description: Supply and Fixing of electrical fixtures, Lightings, Fans etc., and complete wiring as specified in e-portal price schedule for one no. of PC-6 residential building in SVP colony. While doing electrical wiring, the colour code of Red for phase, Black for neutral and green for earthing must be strictly adopted.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer PSO Office SVP Jog

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
If the bidder do not have independent PF then PF declaration in prescrible format in stamp paper of Rs.100 duly notarized shall be upload.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidders shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of freight & insurance, transportation, loading & unloading supply, installation and testing charges as per the latest GOK/GOI orders.
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose often meet the PQR and technical specification of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened.

Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the Corporation, The bidders who have prviously entered into an agreement for any works in Karnataka Power Corporation,Jogfalls and have not yet completed the work even after completion of scheduled delivery and work completion period, then such bidders bid will be rejected.

The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in tender may vary depending on the requirement at the time of placing of the work order, KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submited by them are liablee for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Firm should have successfully carried out the work of Supply and fixing of electrical fixtures with contract order value more than Rs.0.57 Lakhs to any reputed organization. In proof of the above, copies of work orders and corresponding work completion certificate with contract value not less than Rs. 0.57 Lakhs and valid Electrical license shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of work order and corresponding work completion certificate.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have an average annual turnover of Rs 1.15 Lakh in any two financial years from the last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). In proof, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of annual turnover certificate/ profit & loss statement duly certified by Chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited CA certificate of Annual Turn Over/ Profit and Loss Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be regular Class-I Electrical contractor/agency/firm

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Valid GST Registration certificate issued from competent authority

The bid of the bidders whose contracts have been terminated foreclosed in KPCL elsewhere during last three years and also who do not meet the above Pre-Qualifying requirement will be rejected scanned copy of self declaration as per the prescribed format shall be uploaded by the bidder in e-portal.
The bidder shall duly fill and sign the form of bid as in the tender document and the scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded by the bidder in e-portal.
The bidder shall furnish PF registration certificate. If the bidder do not have independent PF then PF declaration format in stamp paper of Rs.100 duly notarized shall be uploaded.
